office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions and small civil cases for all of Ferry County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Sarah Cuellar, elected in 2024, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Ferry County District Court Judge since 2024 and a Republic lawyer in private practice from 2015.
highlights: Elected in 2024 over Nick Force, 1,957 to 1,529 [S2]
Reviving the county's Drug Court as a Therapeutic Court [S1]
Secured state grants for post-conviction compliance; seeks funding for pre-trial services [S1]
